statement: Scores every VALID row: within-user ranking over each user's logged impressions.
Honours SEED and DEVICE from the environment for reproducibility and device placement.
Calls report.progress during training so the harness can watch loss and stall.
Checkpoints via report.checkpoint.save so resume and sensitivity checks have artifacts.
No label-derived feature uses the row's own label (no self-label leakage).
Reads oracle features only, never oracle labels.
Never opens a raw kit log; reads only the TRAIN, VALID and ORACLE paths.
